test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is most nearly similar in meaning to the word ‘Access’ as used in the passage?

options.text: To be able to increase something
To be able to decrease something
To be able to obtain something

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the context of the passage, **'access'** refers to the **ability or permission to obtain or reach something.**
 
• It specifically mentions that the two cupboards, where Rao kept his important papers and clues to his life, were locked and the keys were hidden.
 
• By stating "so that no one could have access to the two cupboards," it implies that no one else could obtain or gain entry to those cupboards without Rao's knowledge or permission.
 
• Therefore, option 4,** "To be able to obtain something,**" best **captures the meaning of 'access' **as used in the passage.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- *'To be able to obtain something'.*
